title: Wok-Wok Steamed Syrian Clams Wrap
description: A rich and indulgent Syrian dish featuring clams, steamed in a wok with spices and herbs, served in a crispy corn husk wrap.
instructions: Preheat a large wok or skillet over medium heat.
Add the unsalted butter and let it melt.
Add the garlic and ginger paste and sauté for 1 minute.
Add the clams, paprika, salt, and black pepper. Stir to combine.
Add 2 cups of water to the wok and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and cover the wok with a lid.
Steam the clams for 3-4 minutes or until they open.
Remove the clams from the wok and set them aside.
Add the parsley, feta cheese, and lemon juice to the wok.
Stir to combine and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
Warm the corn husk wraps according to the package instructions.
Assemble the wraps by placing the clam mixture onto the center of each wrap and serving immediately.
